customer: Quick question about my SUV trade-in here in California. Do I still need to pay my car loan this month, or does your payoff take care of it? New baby at home, so I'd rather not have to keep track of this.
agent: Yes, please keep making your regular loan payments until your lender confirms the loan is paid off. Our payoff covers the amount your lender quoted, but a missed payment in the meantime can be reported as late on your credit history. If a payment goes through after the payoff, your lender will refund it to you, as explained in our article "Getting back an extra loan payment." Congratulations on the new arrival!
